below_6.5: The water is more acidic than the acceptable reference range.
Avoid using the water for drinking until the cause is investigated.
Consider testing the water source and checking for possible contamination.
6.5_to_8.5: The pH is within the acceptable reference range.
above_8.5: The water is more alkaline than the acceptable reference range.
Avoid using the water for drinking until the cause is investigated.

below_or_equal_500: TDS is within the acceptable reference limit.
500_to_2000: TDS is above the acceptable reference limit.
The water requires attention and further assessment.
If possible, use an alternative water source for drinking.
above_2000: TDS exceeds the permissible reference limit.
Avoid using the water for drinking until it is properly assessed or treated.
Consider testing the water source to identify the cause of high dissolved solids.

below_or_equal_1: Turbidity is within the acceptable reference limit.
1_to_5: Turbidity is above the acceptable reference limit.
The water should be investigated for suspended particles or other possible causes.
Consider filtration or further water-quality testing before drinking.
above_5: Turbidity exceeds the permissible reference limit.
Avoid using the water for drinking until it is properly assessed or treated.
Consider filtration and additional water-quality testing.

all_values: Temperature is monitored as an input to the deep learning model; temperature alone does not determine drinking-water safety in this project.

safe: All monitored parameters are within this project's configured reference ranges. Continue routine monitoring.
warning: At least one monitored parameter requires attention. Verify the reading and consider further testing or appropriate treatment before drinking.
unsafe: One or more monitored parameters are outside the configured permissible limits or the CNN-LSTM model predicts Unsafe. Avoid drinking the water until it has been assessed and appropriate treatment or verification is completed.
insufficient_data: A reliable overall classification is unavailable because valid sensor or model data are missing. Check the data connection and collect at least 10 valid chronological readings before relying on a model result.

important_note: Recommendations are based only on the parameters monitored by this project and the available reference rules. They do not replace complete laboratory testing or professional water-quality assessment.
